## Referências básicas

- Faraway, J. J. (2014). [Linear Model with R (2nd Ed.)](https://wangyang-bucket.oss-cn-beijing.aliyuncs.com/cms/image/Linear%20Models%20With%20R_1676789263894.pdf). ChapmanHall/CRC.

- Faraway, J. J. (2016). [Extending the Linear Model with R (2nd Ed.)](https://englianhu.wordpress.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/01/faraway-extending-the-linear-model-with-r-e28093-2006.pdf). ChapmanHall/CRC.

- Stasinopoulos et al. (2017). [Flexible Regression and Smoothing
: Using GAMLSS in R.](https://www.taylorfrancis.com/books/mono/10.1201/b21973/flexible-regression-smoothing-mikis-stasinopoulos-robert-rigby-gillian-heller-vlasios-voudouris-fernanda-de-bastiani). Chapman and Hall/CRC.

- Wood, S. N. (2017). [Generalized Additive Models: An Introduction with R (2nd Ed.)](https://www.taylorfrancis.com/books/mono/10.1201/9781315370279/generalized-additive-models-simon-wood). Chapman and Hall/CRC.


<br>

## Referências complementares

- Bolker, B.M. (2008). [Ecological models and data in R](http://www.leg.ufpr.br/lib/exe/fetch.php/wiki:internas:biblioteca:bolker.pdf). Princeton University Press.

- Gelman, A. et al. (2020). [Regression and Other Stories](https://avehtari.github.io/ROS-Examples/). Cambridge University Press.

- Zuur, A.F., et al. (2009). [Mixed effects models and extensions in ecology with R](https://link.springer.com/book/10.1007/978-0-387-87458-6). Springer.
